name: popover
title: Popover
description: A popover component built on Radix UI with arrow indicator, close button, and directional animations. Uses namespace exports: Popover.Root, Popover.Trigger, Popover.Content, Popover.Close, Popover.Anchor.

migration.guide: API changed: import as namespace `import * as Popover from ...`, use `<Popover.Root>`, `<Popover.Trigger>`, `<Popover.Content>`, `<Popover.Close>`. Old named exports `{ Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent, PopoverAnchor }` removed. `usePortal` prop removed (always uses portal). New props: `showArrow` (default true), `unstyled`. New sub-component: `Popover.Close` with absolute positioning.

docs.lead: A popover component with arrow indicator, close button, and directional slide animations.
docs.usage:
import * as Popover from "@/components/ui/popover"

<Popover.Root>
  <Popover.Trigger>Open</Popover.Trigger>
  <Popover.Content>
    <Popover.Close />
    Content here
  </Popover.Content>
</Popover.Root>

examples.title: Demo
examples.description: Popover with icon, description, close button, and footer actions.
examples.code:
<Popover.Root>
  <Popover.Trigger asChild>
    <Button.Root>Open Popover</Button.Root>
  </Popover.Trigger>
  <Popover.Content className="w-80">
    <Popover.Close asChild>
      <CompactButton.Root size="large" variant="ghost">
        <CompactButton.Icon as={RiCloseLine} />
      </CompactButton.Root>
    </Popover.Close>
    Content here
  </Popover.Content>
</Popover.Root>

examples.title: Position
examples.description: Popovers positioned on top, left, and right sides.

api.name: Popover.Root
api.description: The root popover container. Passes through Radix Popover.Root props.

api.name: Popover.Trigger
api.description: The element that triggers the popover.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element using Radix Slot

api.name: Popover.Content
api.description: The popover content panel with arrow indicator.

props.name: side
props.description: The preferred side to position the popover

props.name: align
props.description: The alignment relative to the trigger

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance in pixels from the trigger

props.name: showArrow
props.description: Show the arrow indicator pointing to the trigger

api.name: Popover.Close
api.description: Close button positioned absolutely in the top-right corner.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element using Radix Slot

api.name: Popover.Anchor
api.description: An optional anchor element for custom positioning.
